description: SEC EDGAR company filings and financials for a stock ticker or CIK in one call: latest 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K and other forms with dates, accession numbers, primary document and index URLs, plus optional XBRL facts (revenue, net income, shares outstanding). Useful for company research, due diligence and earnings monitoring. Errors: 400 JSON {error} for an unknown ticker; 503 while the shared SEC rate limit is busy. PAID: $0.003 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/sec/filings.
name: sec_filings
